body:
Parent: #423. This is a bounded, source-only geography follow-up from the merged #992 research packet. It remains blocked until #423 is completed; its exact subject IDs and baseline input hashes are pinned below.

## Goal

For the exact 67 Serbian location IDs in the #423 packet, establish present-day and dated administrative role, official code/name and parent through authoritative statistical/administrative registers; seek an authoritative current geospatial unit source with dated vintage and lawful reuse terms, or record explicit restoration instructions. Keep this disjoint from #998’s exact 78 IDs; coordinate/reuse common country-level source evidence without duplicating subject work.

## Acceptance

- Reproduce an exact per-ID source identity/role/name/parent crosswalk for these 67 subjects and inspect all relevant parent relationships and neighboring granularity.
- Inspect dated primary statistical and geospatial-register evidence; retain redistributable original bytes or lawful restoration instructions with exact hashes, retrieval dates, vintage, license and completeness limits.
- Separate administrative roster agreement from legal boundary or polygon-equivalence evidence. If current unit polygons are unavailable, state the exact gap and restoration request without inferring boundaries.
- Provide sourced ID-preserving engineering handoffs where warranted; do not modify shared geography, publish, import or certify the region.

## Evidence and limits

The pinned #423 unit ledger and 2017 geoBoundaries SRB ADM2 source are named in the issue evidence pins. #998 covers a disjoint 78-ID Serbia subset (the exact ID intersection with these 67 is zero) and its in-progress SORS source investigation may inform country-level source retrieval after it is available.

All outcomes are research findings, not geographic approval or authorization to publish/import. Preserve existing packet sources, release pins, identities, and other workers’ evidence.



2026-10-05 (America/Los_Angeles, 12:29) source reuse update: #998 / PR #1014 is now merged and closed. Its retained SORS 2017/current rosters, retrieval record and derived crosswalk are pinned below from the merged evidence packet. These inputs support reuse of country-level evidence only; this issue still owns independent crosswalk findings for its exact 67 subjects and needs authoritative dated current geometry or restoration instructions. Exact subject intersection with #998 is zero.
